text:
olivia.marketing: quick kickoff 1519 We need a microcopy pass for the three product heroes (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) plus a clear CTA -> lead routing matrix for webinar vs demo vs start. Keep engineers front-and-center and surface economics. Can everyone drop 1-2 variants and routing rules by EOD?
maria.copy: Hosted option 1: 'Hosted API 1s to integrate, pay-per-use.' subhead: 'Curated models, predictable billing.' Hosted option 2: 'Hosted API 10x faster to prototype.' subhead: 'Start in minutes, scale without infra.'
sam.growth: for benchmarks under hosted hero we could show one line: 'Avg gen latency 45ms (512 tokens) — typical infra savings 3x.' Or just value: 'Prototype faster, ship cheaper.' We'll A/B test.
tariq.ops: Dedicated hero lines: D1: 'Dedicated capacity 1reserved GPUs for production.' subhead: 'Configurable autoscale, SLA-backed latency.' D2: 'Predictable throughput, lower tail latency.' subhead: 'Reserved pools + burst capacity.'
maria.copy: Private hero variants: P1: 'Private deployment VPC and on-prem options.' subhead: 'KMS, audit logs, and compliance controls.' P2: 'Bring Redwood into your network.' subhead: 'Air-gapped option for regulated workloads.'
ben.salesbot: Routing rules (starter): "Join webinar" -> growth@, "Request demo" -> ae@, "Start free" -> onboarding@. Add tags: source=hero, product_mode={hosted,dedicated,private}, cta=...
tariq.ops: snippet for frontend devs: ```js
// hero CTA routing
const routeMap = {
  'Join webinar': 'growth',
  'Request demo': 'sales',
  'Start free': 'onboarding'
}
sendLead(lead, routeMap[cta])
```
sam.growth: CTA pairing recs: - paid acquisition -> primary = Start free, secondary = Request demo - developer community / docs -> primary = Join webinar, secondary = Start free - outbound enterprise -> primary = Request demo, secondary = Join webinar
maria.copy: microcopy compact variants (character counts): Hosted A: 'Hosted API Start generating today.' (33) Hosted B: 'No infra, just HTTP calls.' (28) Dedicated A: 'Reserved GPUs, steady throughput.' (32) Dedicated B: 'SLA-backed dedicated pools.' (30) Private A: 'Control plane in your VPC.' (25) Private B: 'On4A5prem & air-gapped options.' (31)
olivia.marketing: love these. Next: Maria, put variants into the doc and mark the primary and alt for the AB. Sam, set up AB for hosted hero metric vs benefit. Tariq, confirm tag names + fallback routing (e.g., if growth queue > X, route webinar -> nurture). Ben, have salesbot add cta metadata. I'll book a 20m review Wednesday 09:30 PT to pick winners.
tariq.ops: fallback plan: if growth queue depth > 200 -> route webinar signups to nurture list and tag `delayed-webinar`. draft config at https://rbw.md/routing-draft-2
sam.growth: i'll create two hero mockups and push to the doc by EOD for visual QA.
maria.copy: done — i've added microcopy with punchier and more technical hooks. Ping for tone tweaks.
ben.salesbot: automated tagging configured: `utm_source=hero`, `hero_variant=hosted_metricA` etc. Will include lead score hints for AE prioritization.
olivia.marketing: great work team 44F let's converge on the doc before the sprint email goes out. Thanks!
